This work will also reduce the likelihood of unexpected power cuts in the future. We appreciate that some customers may have experienced unplanned power cuts in the last 6 months. To maintain your electricity supply during the work, we'll temporarily connect your property to a generator. There will be brief interruptions to your power while it is connected and removed. If you have solar panels, please switch them off to keep them safely isolated. If your system has an 'island mode' (sometimes called backup or standby mode) you can use that instead. This helps prevent any issues during the power cut. This work is taking place in the Clayhithe Road area.

Thanks for your patience today. We know a power cut can be difficult, especially in colder weather.

Many properties have gas hobs, which can still be used in a power cut for cooking, or heating water for drinks and sterilisation of baby bottles. The spark to ignite the hob will not work however, so if you do use it please take extra care when using other ignition sources like matches or lighters. Even in daytime, the light in your house may be low in a power cut, so only do this if you are confident it can be done safely.

If you have any questions or concerns, our team are always on hand to help.

We believe there may be a fault on our underground electricity cabling in the area, but currently it has not developed to a stage that our staff can pinpoint it. Steps.Message:
I appreciate your continued patience this morning. We want to be as transparent as possible as we know having multiple power cuts is disruptive and worrying, so I would like to help explain why we can't always fix a problem like this right away.

Underground electricity cabling is insulated for safety and if a fault develops, these materials can re-seal due to heat passing through them when our safety equipment operates and your power is lost. This covers any potential fault again, meaning our staff cannot locate it using their tests or specialist equipment.

We'll know more once our staff contact us again, so I'll be in touch again shortly.

We know that being without power can be especially difficult, so we're sorry for the outage. Please rest assured our staff will continue to work around the clock to keep the lights on.

If your power isn't on or there's anything you'd like to talk to us about, call us on 08003163105 which is free from landlines and mobiles.

Our engineers have arrived on site in the Highfield Avenue  area, the estimated time of 19:00-20:00 hasn't changed.

We know that a power cut can be very disruptive; we understand this can greatly impact your daily activities and we want to support you however we can.

We'll update you with all of our progress, but if you need to speak to us, call our team on 08003163105 any time. If you would like more information about what we think the fault is; here's a short YouTube video https://UKPN.short.gy/fuse Sent by Jack at 15:47.

Sent by Jack at 15:40 - Some customers have told us that they want to be notified about a power cut before it happens. We're sorry we couldn't give you advance notice about this power cut. The issue happened suddenly and without warning, leaving us with no time to alert customers.

Our electricity network is regularly inspected and maintained to help prevent outages, but occasionally an unexpected fault can lead to an unplanned power cut. It's similar to a car that's been fully serviced and passed its MOT but still breaks down without warning.
Thank you for your understanding and we will keep you updated about todays outage until you are restored.

Sent by Jack at 15:39 - Engineers are on their way. At this point we think the issue is a fault with equipment in your local substation in the Highfield Avenue  area. We didn't know this was going to happen, so time frames we provide throughout are estimated and are subject to change.

Our estimated time to have power back on is currently between 19:00 and 20:00, but after we arrive and assess the situation this may change. The reason for this is there can sometimes be a more complex underlying issue found by our engineer's tests which may take longer, and if not we may get power back on sooner.

All of our texts are written and sent personally by our team, and we'll let you know once our staff arrive.

Power cut alert from UK Power Networks at [TIME].

We're letting you know about an unplanned power cut affecting 1/3 of properties in [postcode]. Not all customers will be affected, and you may still have power.

Get live updates on our website: https://www.ukpowernetworks.co.uk/power-cut/

To verify who we are, you can access the above page by Googling UK Power Networks.

We notify our Priority Service Customers of outages 24 hours a day. If you need extra help or support, please call us on 08003163105.
